storyCards.headline: Who Can It Be Now: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Men At Work's "Who Can It Be Now" reached #1 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #1 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 27 weeks on the chart.

Who Can It Be Now was released in 1982.
